name: Can a buyer agent help me with new construction homes?

mainEntity.name: Can a buyer agent help me with new construction homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a buyer agent can definitely assist with new construction homes. Many buyers mistakenly believe they don't need an agent when buying new, but having independent representation ensures your interests are protected during negotiations with the builder. Your agent can help review contracts, understand builder incentives, and guide you through the construction process. Engaging an agent early, before visiting builder sales offices, is crucial for securing their advocacy.
acceptedAnswer.description: A buyer agent can assist with new construction homes, protecting your interests during negotiations and contract review. It's best to engage them before contacting builders directly.
